content: .{@-अनुप्रासः@} one of the five kinds of अनुप्रासs, ‘the single alliteration’, which is a similarity occurring {%once%} (or singly) and in more than one way among a collection of consonants; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} आदाय बकुलगन्धानन्धीकुर्वन् पदे पदे भ्रमरान् . अयमेति मन्दमन्दं कावेरीवारिपावनः पवनः .. <ls>S. D. 634</ls>.
